verdict.line: You lose if Renekton catches you with a 50+ Fury W combo before you have E to answer; you win if the lane survives to mid game, where your 55.3% Rylai's-Riftmaker-Liandry's core takes over.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane at 50.3% over 2612 games because both champions have a hard engage tool on a real cooldown — your E (Death's Grasp, 16/14/12/10/8s) pulls him in, his W (Ruthless Predator, 16/14/12/10/8s) stuns you — and whoever's engage tool is up controls the trade. Renekton's Fury resource (Reign of Anger) is the swing variable: below 50 Fury he's just a melee stick-fighter you can out-trade, above 50 Fury his Q and W both get materially stronger. Your skill order puts E online at level 2, so from early you have a real punish tool for his dash cooldowns rather than just tanking hits.

theirWindow.when: Renekton sits above 50 Fury with W ready
theirWindow.what: Above 50 Fury his Q (Cull the Meek) does increased damage and heal, and his W becomes a 3-hit slash that strips shields, stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s, and hits hard. Don't let him walk up to melee range on his terms here — hold W (Indestructible) to eat the burst, since it can't be shield-broken if it's already up.

yourWindow.when: right after his E (Slice and Dice) dash is spent
yourWindow.what: Slice and Dice is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s on cooldown — once he's committed it to engage or reposition, he has no gap-closer back. Land E (Death's Grasp, 700 range) to pull him into your Q (Obliterate), which hits hardest on a single target.

start.why: Measured at 46.2% over 485 games (15.2% pick) for this matchup — the flat damage reduction on autos blunts his early poke and all-in attempts while his Fury is still building.

boots.why: Taken in 83.1% of games at 50.4% win rate. Renekton's damage is almost entirely auto-attacks and physical ability hits, so the attack-damage reduction directly cuts his trade output.

core.why: First item in the strongest measured path (55.3% over 188 games). The slow from your Q and E makes it much harder for him to disengage after Slice and Dice is down.
Second in that same 55.3% path — omnivamp sustains you through extended trades once his burst window has passed.
Closes out the top-performing build path and scales your sustained damage against his health bar in longer fights.

situational.when: he's ahead and building into lifesteal or crit, since it appears in a 54.2% core path alongside Rylai's
he's sustaining through your trades off Cull the Meek's heal and you need the extra healing cut

runes.keystoneWhy: This is the measured 55.2%-pick page for the matchup — Conqueror's stacking damage and the healing it grants on stacks lets you win the extended, grindy trades this even lane produces.

summoners.why: The highest-performing and most-picked combo for this matchup (50.4% win rate, 81.7% pick). Ignite punishes his Cull the Meek sustain directly and secures kills once you win a trade.

playing.title: Track Fury before trading
playing.detail: Below 50 Fury his Q and W are their base, weaker versions. Initiate trades here rather than waiting for him to stack Fury off autos.

playing.title: Pull on dash cooldown
playing.detail: Slice and Dice is his only gap-closer. The moment he's used it, you have a free 700-range E (Death's Grasp) window with no retaliation dash available to him.

playing.title: Save W for the 3-hit combo
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage you take to shield you. Pop it right before he lands an empowered W so the shield absorbs the 1.5s-stun combo instead of being broken by it.

playing.title: Single-target with Q when isolated
playing.detail: Obliterate's damage is increased when it hits only him, so don't bait it into minions if you're trying to win a 1v1 trade.

playing.title: Respect his level 2 all-in
playing.detail: His W-Q combo comes online before your E does if he hits level 2 first off a cannon wave or fast clear. Play for trades, not all-ins, until you have E.

playing.title: Don't force fights into his ultimate
playing.detail: Dominus (120/100/80/80/80s) gives him bonus health and periodic Fury generation. If he's just transformed, disengage and wait him out rather than trading into the bonus health bar.

playing.title: Play for the midgame item spike
playing.detail: Your Rylai's-Riftmaker-Liandry's core (55.3% win rate) is the actual win condition here — prioritize surviving lane over forcing kills if the trades stay even.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from current-patch OP.GG games for this exact matchup; the trade-pattern and timing analysis is my own reading of the kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Bramble Vest and other items that increase armor before closing in to fight Renekton. Keep in mind that his reinforced (W) can go through armor.
